landing.metaTitle: SmartLink | Network ya Mafuta ku Malawi

modal.title: Sankhani Chilankhulo
modal.description: Sankhani chilankhulo chimene mukufuna kugwiritsa ntchito pa SmartLink.
modal.englishDescription: Gwiritsani SmartLink mu Chingerezi pa ntchito zonse.
modal.chichewaDescription: Gwiritsani SmartLink mu Chichewa kuti njira ikhale yosavuta.
modal.note: Mutha kusintha chilankhulo ichi nthawi ina pa menyu yapamwamba.

hero.subtitle: SmartLink imalumikiza oyendetsa, ogwira ntchito pa station, ma fleet, ndi anzawo kuti onse awone supply, mizere, malipiro, ndi kayendedwe ka station pa nthawi yeniyeni.
hero.metric1Label: Availability, mtundu wa mafuta, ndi service readiness mu view imodzi
hero.metric2Label: Oyendetsa amaona kuchuluka kwa demand asanafike pa station
hero.metric3Label: Wallet, prepay, reservation, ndi reconciliation zikukonzeka
hero.panelTitle: Yapangidwa kuti igwire ntchito zenizeni za forecourt.
hero.panelSub: Operating layer yomveka bwino ya supply, mizere, service windows, malipiro, ndi malipoti.
hero.summary1Body: Stock ndi service status kuchokera ku ma station
hero.tileOpsBody: Ma dashboard, telemetry, ndi kuwongolera ntchito zonse.

mapPreview.title: Sankhani route pogwiritsa ntchito zinthu zenizeni za station, osati mphekesera.
mapPreview.subtitle: Oyendetsa amafanana ma station apafupi, kutsimikiza mtundu wa mafuta, kuwona wait pressure, ndi kusankha stop yabwino musanayende.
mapPreview.bullet1: Onani ma station ndi momwe mzere ulili
mapPreview.bullet3: Landirani ma alert pa kusintha kwa service

how.title: Kuyambira pa kusaka mpaka pa kulandira service mu masitepe atatu osavuta.
how.subtitle: Njira yomweyi imapatsa oyendetsa chidziwitso pomwe ma station amalandira deta yolondola.
how.step1Body: Onani kupezeka kwa mafuta, mzere, ndi mtunda.
how.step2Title: Lowani mu mzere kapena sungitsani nthawi
how.step2Body: Sankhani station yoyenera ndi kuchepetsa kusatsimikiza.
how.step3Body: Fikani ndi chidziwitso chokwanira cha nthawi ndi service.

features.title: Control layer ya kayendedwe ka mafuta
features.subtitle: SmartLink imamangidwa pa zisankho zenizeni za pa station: kupita kuti, pali mafuta ati, mzere ndi wautali bwanji, ndi momwe transaction ikulandilidwa.
features.availabilityBody: Onetsani availability, service status, ndi confidence ya station asanayende.
features.queueBody: Onetsani wait pressure, gawani demand ku ma station apafupi, ndi kutsegula reservation windows.
features.reservationBody: Thandizani malipiro a digito kuti counter ikhale yosavuta ndi settlement iwoneke bwino.
features.verifiedBody: Attendants ndi managers asinthe pumps, queues, deliveries, ndi service readiness pa malo amodzi.
features.alertsBody: Events za operation zisanduke exports, alerts, reconciliation, ndi malipoti okonzekera MERA.
features.transparencyBody: Perekani information yoyera kwa oyendetsa ndi anzawo pa supply, wait time, service, ndi accountability.

stations.title: Operating layer imodzi ya oyendetsa, ma station, ma fleet, ndi anzawo.
stations.subtitle: Kwa oyendetsa SmartLink imakhala yosavuta, koma kumbuyo kwake imapatsa operators control surface yamphamvu.
stations.description: Gwiritsani SmartLink kuchepetsa kudzaza pa station, kukonza kulumikizana, kuthandiza malipiro a digito, ndi kupanga operational data yoyera.
stations.driversBody: Pezani mafuta mwachangu, fananitsani mizere, sungitsani nthawi, ndi kulipira mosavuta.
stations.stationsBody: Yendetsani demand ndi kusunga station ikuyenda bwino.
stations.enterpriseBody: Yendetsani ma fleet ndi ma station ambiri mu pulatifomu imodzi.
stations.devTitle: Integrations zogwirizana ndi station infrastructure yeniyeni.
stations.devBody: Lumikizani queue events, wallet workflows, telemetry, deliveries, reporting, ndi monitoring mu ma system anu.

trust.title: Yapangidwa kuchepetsa mizere, kukonza kulumikizana kwa station, ndi accountability.
trust.item1Label: Availability ndi mzere zimawoneka nthawi yomweyo
trust.item2Label: Kusungitsa ndi malipiro ali ndi mbiri
trust.item4Label: Ma system a fleet ndi regulators

finalCta.title: Pangani fuel stop iliyonse ikhale yosavuta kupanga plan komanso yosavuta kuyendetsa.
finalCta.subtitle: Tsegulani live map, lembetsani station, kapena konzekeretsani operations team pa queue visibility, malipiro a wallet, ndi station reporting.
finalCta.note: Yapangidwa kwa ogwiritsa ntchito ku Malawi, ma station, ndi anzawo.

footer.tagline: Kupeza mafuta, kuwongolera mzere, kusungitsa, ndi ntchito za ma station mu pulatifomu imodzi.
